name: @askjo/camofox-browser
description: Headless browser automation server and OpenClaw plugin for AI agents - anti-detection, element refs, and session isolation
author: Jo Inc <oss@askjo.ai>

tools.name: camofox_create_tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab at a URL

tools.name: camofox_snapshot
tools.description: Get accessibility snapshot with element refs

tools.name: camofox_click
tools.description: Click an element by ref or CSS selector

tools.name: camofox_type
tools.description: Type text into an element

tools.name: camofox_upload
tools.description: Attach files from the upload directory to an upload control

tools.name: camofox_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to URL or search macro

tools.name: camofox_scroll
tools.description: Scroll page up/down/left/right

tools.name: camofox_screenshot
tools.description: Capture page screenshot

tools.name: camofox_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab

tools.name: camofox_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in a Camoufox tab page context

tools.name: camofox_list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs for a user

tools.name: camofox_activate
tools.description: Bring a Camoufox tab to the front (focus/activate it)

tools.name: camofox_ax
tools.description: Get the raw accessibility tree of a Camoufox page (unfiltered, no element refs)

tools.name: camofox_actionables
tools.description: List the clickable and fillable elements on a Camoufox page as candidate interaction targets, each with its ref

tools.name: camofox_table_rows
tools.description: Read one page of rows from a table on a Camoufox page

tools.name: camofox_mouse_wheel
tools.description: Send a mouse wheel scroll over a specific element (by ref) or coordinate in a Camoufox tab

tools.name: camofox_drag
tools.description: Perform a trusted press-move-release mouse drag between two coordinates in a Camoufox tab

tools.name: camofox_init_script
tools.description: Register a script that runs in the page context before every subsequent navigation in a Camoufox tab

tools.name: camofox_export_storage_state
tools.description: Export the current session cookies and storage state (Playwright storageState format) for the current user

tools.name: camofox_import_local_storage
tools.description: Seed localStorage for one or more HTTP(S) origins in the current session

tools.name: camofox_back
tools.description: Go back one entry in a Camoufox tab's history

tools.name: camofox_forward
tools.description: Go forward one entry in a Camoufox tab's history

tools.name: camofox_refresh
tools.description: Reload the current page in a Camoufox tab

tools.name: camofox_press
tools.description: Press a single keyboard key in a Camoufox tab (e.g., Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown)

tools.name: camofox_select
tools.description: Choose an option in a native <select> dropdown in a Camoufox tab, by ref or CSS selector

tools.name: camofox_viewport
tools.description: Set the viewport (window) size of a Camoufox tab in pixels

tools.name: camofox_wait
tools.description: Wait for a Camoufox page to settle before continuing: up to timeout ms, optionally until the network is idle, optionally dismissing a consent dialog

tools.name: camofox_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from a Camoufox page using a JSON Schema describing the fields to pull out

tools.name: camofox_links
tools.description: List the links on a Camoufox page, with pagination

tools.name: camofox_images
tools.description: List the images on a Camoufox page

tools.name: camofox_import_cookies
tools.description: Import Netscape cookie file (requires CAMOFOX_API_KEY)

scripts.build: tsc -p . || true; mkdir -p dist && cp plugin.js dist/plugin.js
scripts.test:mcp: npm ci --prefix mcp && node scripts/test-mcp.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:plugins
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/generate-openapi.js && git add openclaw.plugin.json mcp/package.json mcp/package-lock.json openapi.json
